title: REA spine: target artifact extraction
status: AUTHORED. The domain the whole repo is ordered around: artifact before request.

atom_notes.A08: extraction is information exposure from the client's own artifacts before any request is sent
atom_notes.A06: bundler paths, chunk names and routes are namespace structure worth reading before probing
atom_notes.A05: minified and compiled code hides shape. deobfuscation is shape recovery
atom_notes.A01: recovered script text tells you which sinks exist, so injection is found by reading not guessing
atom_notes.A16: a page that registers WebMCP tools exposes an interface to the agent layer

required_cells.why: the artifact inventory replaces blind probing and is the entry point of the pipeline
bundle and source map give routes and logic no response would reveal
the mobile or Electron client is often less guarded than the web app
recovered source to hypothesis. this is where extraction pays for itself
targeted probing informed by code, instead of a wordlist
bundle diffing across deploys to catch new endpoints
mobile app version diffing as a monitoring input

tree.q: What do you already have: nothing, a capture, or a client artifact?
tree.why: Each starting point has a different cheapest path, and starting at the wrong one wastes the most expensive resource, which is attention.

branches.action: browse once through the proxy, then inventory the capture. no probing

next.q: Does the capture include response bodies for scripts and API calls?

branches.action: export scripts, analyze the bundle, then map endpoints to source locations
branches.oracle: route present in bundle and absent in capture

branches.action: recapture with bodies enabled. a capture without bodies cannot answer the questions that matter

branches.a: A client artifact (APK, IPA, asar, wasm)

next.q: Is the logic in bytecode or in a bundle inside the package?

branches.action: inspect the package, then class or method level, then trace references to the API client
branches.oracle: endpoint or secret recovered from code

branches.action: extract, then treat as a web bundle. check for webview bridge code
validate and read imports and exports. the interface is the contract
fetch the page, inventory scripts and storage keys, then decide what to acquire next

gaps.gap: No Chromium LevelDB reader for LocalStorage and IndexedDB
gaps.build_candidate: unzip plus a LevelDB library, expose profile and origin scoping
gaps.built_note: reads the write-ahead log with masked CRC32C, joins fragmented records across blocks and parses WriteBatch puts and deletes; sorted tables are out of scope and the tool says so

gaps.gap: No WeChat or Alipay mini program unpacking
gaps.build_candidate: wxapkg parser with entry mapping, China only lane and currently the only way into that surface
gaps.built_note: parses a documented wxapkg shape with traversal refusal, 8 fixture checks; not yet validated against a real package

gaps.build_candidate: libapp.so parsing plus symbol mapping, needed for apps whose logic is not in DEX
gaps.built_note: parses ELF symbol and dynamic tables with no dependencies, locates the four Dart snapshots with offsets and sizes, reports the embedded Dart version and refuses to deserialise. The blutter class recovery is not done.

gaps.gap: No Hermes or React Native bundle recovery
gaps.build_candidate: extract the bundle and recover the JS, then treat as a web bundle
gaps.built_note: reads the header: magic, version, source hash, declared length, function, identifier and string counts, string storage size. Refuses to walk the tables because their offsets move between versions, and warns on an unknown version. The bundle recovery half is not done.

gaps.gap: No HarmonyOS HAP or ABC bytecode support
gaps.built_note: unpacks the container, identifies Ark bytecode and native libraries, parses module.json, refuses traversal; no decompilation and no signature verification

gaps.build_candidate: WARC record walker emitting the same shape as a HAR
gaps.built_note: reads WARC 1.0 response records, plain or gzip, emits HAR-shaped JSON, 7 fixture checks

gaps.gap: No service worker and CacheStorage reconstruction
gaps.build_candidate: CDP CacheStorage enumeration plus stored response bodies
gaps.built_note: parses a CDP capture or a HAR, reports registrations, cache names and entry counts, then classifies each cached entry by whether it is bound to a principal and shared anyway. No CDP transport, so live collection is not implemented.

gaps.build_candidate: parse attestation objects and report origin, RP id hash and UV
gaps.built_note: CBOR decodes the attestation object, splits fmt, attStmt and authData, and reports flags, sign count, AAGUID, credential id and COSE key. No signature or chain verification.

gaps.gap: No request signing recovery from obfuscated JS
gaps.build_candidate: locate the signing function, lift it, and test replayed signatures against a control

gaps.gap: Source map recovery when the map is absent
gaps.build_candidate: bundle structure heuristics plus name demangling, honest about confidence
gaps.built_note: tries an inline data URI map, then an external one, then embedded sourcesContent, decodes VLQ mappings for position lookup; with no map it carves structure and labels confidence low
